tools.name: search_occupations
tools.description: Look up an occupation code, title or page slug within a country. Includes US alternate titles and Canadian English and French example titles. A choose or suggestions result needs the reader’s selection. Omit query to browse the directory. US and Canadian results include job and hiring-budget links.
